title: OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer
snippet: OpenAI and Synopsys are building GPT-Synopsys, a specialized AI model for chip design. It's meant to operate Synopsys' EDA tools like a seasoned engineer and optimize designs on its own.
